def execute(root: Path, plan: dict):
    if socket.gethostname().split('.')[0] != 'p520-llm':
        raise RuntimeError('host guard: must run on p520-llm')
    out = Path(plan['remote_directory'])
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    owner = {
        'host': socket.gethostname(),
        'boot_id': Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip(),
        'launcher_pid': os.getpid(),
        'remote_directory': str(out),
        'run_nonce': uuid.uuid4().hex
    }
    save(out / 'owner.json', owner)
    save(out / 'launch.json', {'command': plan['command'], 'environment_overrides': plan['environment_overrides']})
    save(out / 'experiment-plan.json', plan)
    save(out / 'progress.json', {'phase': 'prepared', **owner})

    save(out / 'preflight.json', preflight())
    integrity = wheel_integrity()
    save(out / 'wheel-integrity.json', integrity)
    if integrity['mismatches']:
        raise RuntimeError(f"installed wheel mismatch: {integrity['mismatches']}; inference refused")

    capture_inventory(root, out)

    env = dict(os.environ)
    env.update(plan['environment_overrides'])

    samples = []
    stop = threading.Event()

    def observe():
        with (out / 'telemetry.jsonl').open('x') as f:
            while not stop.is_set():
                sample = {'observed_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'gpus': [], 'gpu_error': None}
                try:
                    sample['gpus'] = read_gpus(3)
                except Exception as exc:
                    sample['gpu_error'] = str(exc)
                samples.append(sample)
                f.write(json.dumps(sample) + '\n')
                f.flush()
                stop.wait(1)

    observer = threading.Thread(target=observe)
    observer.start()

    def interrupted(signum, frame):
        raise InterruptedError(f'launcher signal {signum}')
    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, interrupted)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, interrupted)

    started = time.monotonic()
    process = None
    results = []
    error = None

    try:
        with (out / 'server.log').open('x') as log:
            process = subprocess.Popen(plan['command'], stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, env=env, start_new_session=True)
            save(out / 'progress.json', {'phase': 'running', 'server_pid': process.pid, **owner})
            adapter = HTTPAdapter('http://127.0.0.1:18080', RUNTIME, timeout_s=2)
            deadline = time.monotonic() + plan['timeouts_s']['startup']
            while process.poll() is None and time.monotonic() < deadline:
                if adapter.health()['healthy']:
                    break
                time.sleep(1)

            ready = adapter.health()['healthy']
            server_returncode = process.poll()
            save(out / 'startup.json', {'ready': ready, 'process_returncode': server_returncode, 'elapsed_s': time.monotonic() - started})

            adapter.timeout_s = plan['timeouts_s']['request_inactivity']
            for config in plan['configs']:
                exp_out = root / 'results/raw' / config['experiment_id']
                verdict = run_batch(exp_out, config, plan['workload'], adapter)
                results.append({'experiment_id': config['experiment_id'], 'verdict': verdict})
                if not ready:
                    break
    except BaseException as exc:
        error = f'{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}'
        save(out / 'progress.json', {'phase': 'interrupted', **owner, 'error': error})
        raise
    finally:
        try:
            if process is not None and process.poll() is None:
                os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
                try:
                    process.wait(timeout=20)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                    process.wait(timeout=10)
        finally:
            stop.set()
            if observer:
                observer.join(timeout=5)
            save(out / 'telemetry-summary.json', summarize(samples, duration_s=time.monotonic() - started, interval_s=1))
            save(out / 'after.json', {
                'gpus': read_gpus(5),
                'compute_apps': subprocess.check_output(['nvidia-smi', '--query-compute-apps=pid', '--format=csv,noheader'], text=True)
            })
            save(out / 'exit.json', {
                'error': error,
                'server_returncode': process.returncode if process else None,
                'ended_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
            })

    save(out / 'completion.json', {'phase': 'results_saved', 'experiments': results})
    save(out / 'progress.json', {'phase': 'results_saved', **owner})
    print(json.dumps(results, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), flush=True)
    return results


def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument('--kv', choices=list(KV_CONFIGS.keys()), default='fp8_e5m2', help='KV cache choice (fp8_e5m2 or fp16)')
    p.add_argument('--series', type=int, default=None, help='Experiment series number (e.g. 40 for FP8, 41 for FP16)')
    p.add_argument('--root', type=Path, default=Path('.'), help='Root path of repository')
    p.add_argument('--plan-only', action='store_true', help='Offline plan inspection only; no execution')
    args = p.parse_args()

    plan = build_plan(args.root.resolve(), args.kv, args.series)
    if args.plan_only:
        print(json.dumps(plan, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    else:
        execute(args.root.resolve(), plan)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Phase 4 — 1Cat-vLLM / V100 Serving offline execution plan and matrix validation.

Defines the frozen 9-point performance matrix (7 FP8 E5M2 + 2 FP16),
fail-fast dependency rules, prerequisite gates, and single-execution policy.
This module produces execution plans and validates rules; it never executes GPU inference.
"""
import argparse
import json
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Set, Tuple

# Pinned Phase 4 configuration constants
RUNTIME = "1Cat-vLLM"
RUNTIME_REVISION = "1cat-vllm 1.5.0 wheel sha256:2a4d6bee4e19d315b142f2c563059f3064ddeeca563a6bdc828c33e1073c825b"
MODEL_PATH = "/srv/models/qwen3.8-vllm/Qwen3.8-27B-QUASAR-NVFP4"
WEIGHT_QUANT = "NVFP4"
SPECULATION = "target-only"
DFLASH2_STATUS = "SKIPPED"

# KV Cache options and CLI flags
KV_FP8 = "fp8_e5m2"
KV_FP16 = "auto"

# Frozen Performance Matrix (9 points total: 7 FP8 E5M2 + 2 FP16)
FP8_C1_POINTS = ["32K", "64K", "96K", "128K"]
FP8_CONCURRENCY_POINTS = [("32K", 4), ("32K", 5), ("64K", 4)]

FP16_C1_POINTS = ["128K"]
FP16_CONCURRENCY_POINTS = [("64K", 4)]

# Forbidden matrix points (explicitly excluded from default matrix)
FORBIDDEN_POINTS: Set[Tuple[str, str, int]] = {
    # (kv_cache, context, concurrency)
    (KV_FP8, "64K", 5),
    (KV_FP8, "96K", 4),
    (KV_FP8, "96K", 5),
    (KV_FP8, "128K", 4),
    (KV_FP8, "128K", 5),
    (KV_FP16, "32K", 1),
    (KV_FP16, "64K", 1),
    (KV_FP16, "96K", 1),
    (KV_FP16, "32K", 4),
    (KV_FP16, "32K", 5),
    (KV_FP16, "64K", 5),
    (KV_FP16, "96K", 4),
    (KV_FP16, "96K", 5),
    (KV_FP16, "128K", 4),
    (KV_FP16, "128K", 5),
}


def get_base_matrix() -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Returns the ordered base 9-point performance matrix."""
    matrix = []
    # 1-4: FP8 C1 context frontier
    for ctx in FP8_C1_POINTS:
        matrix.append({
            "kv_cache": KV_FP8,
            "kv_cache_dtype_flag": "--kv-cache-dtype fp8_e5m2",
            "concurrency": 1,
            "context": ctx,
            "role": "frontier",
            "measured_repetitions": 1,
            "full_size_warmup": 0,
        })
    # 5-7: FP8 Concurrency
    matrix.append({
        "kv_cache": KV_FP8,
        "kv_cache_dtype_flag": "--kv-cache-dtype fp8_e5m2",
        "concurrency": 4,
        "context": "32K",
        "role": "primary multi-agent",
        "measured_repetitions": 1,
        "full_size_warmup": 0,
    })
    matrix.append({
        "kv_cache": KV_FP8,
        "kv_cache_dtype_flag": "--kv-cache-dtype fp8_e5m2",
        "concurrency": 4,
        "context": "64K",
        "role": "large-context multi-agent (mandatory comparison)",
        "measured_repetitions": 1,
        "full_size_warmup": 0,
    })
    matrix.append({
        "kv_cache": KV_FP8,
        "kv_cache_dtype_flag": "--kv-cache-dtype fp8_e5m2",
        "concurrency": 5,
        "context": "32K",
        "role": "peak concurrency",
        "measured_repetitions": 1,
        "full_size_warmup": 0,
    })
    # 8: FP16 C1 control
    matrix.append({
        "kv_cache": KV_FP16,
        "kv_cache_dtype_flag": "--kv-cache-dtype auto",
        "concurrency": 1,
        "context": "128K",
        "role": "KV control (C1 128K vs FP8)",
        "measured_repetitions": 1,
        "full_size_warmup": 0,
    })
    # 9: FP16 C4 control
    matrix.append({
        "kv_cache": KV_FP16,
        "kv_cache_dtype_flag": "--kv-cache-dtype auto",
        "concurrency": 4,
        "context": "64K",
        "role": "KV control (C4 64K vs FP8 & llama.cpp Fallback)",
        "measured_repetitions": 1,
        "full_size_warmup": 0,
    })
    return matrix


def evaluate_execution_plan(
    fp8_supported: bool = True,
    fp8_c1_capacity_verdicts: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
    fp8_c4_32k_capacity_verdict: Optional[str] = None,
    fp8_c5_32k_capacity_verdict: Optional[str] = None,
    fp16_c1_128k_capacity_verdict: Optional[str] = None,
    fp16_c4_64k_capacity_verdict: Optional[str] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Evaluates the Phase 4 execution plan applying all fail-fast and prerequisite rules.

    Returns a dict containing:
      - 'planned_points': list of executed points with status ('RUN' or 'SKIP') and reasons.
      - 'run_count': total number of RUN points.
      - 'skip_count': total number of SKIP points.
    """
    if fp8_c1_capacity_verdicts is None:
        fp8_c1_capacity_verdicts = {}

    plan = []

    # Check FP8 support
    fp8_available = fp8_supported

    # 1. FP8 C1 Frontier (32K -> 64K -> 96K -> 128K)
    fp8_c1_failed_at = None
    for ctx in FP8_C1_POINTS:
        item = {
            "kv_cache": KV_FP8,
            "concurrency": 1,
            "context": ctx,
            "status": "RUN",
            "reason": "frontier point",
        }
        if not fp8_available:
            item["status"] = "SKIP"
            item["reason"] = "FP8 E5M2 unsupported in pinned runtime/hardware"
        elif fp8_c1_failed_at is not None:
            item["status"] = "SKIP"
            item["reason"] = f"FP8 C1 fail-fast: lower context {fp8_c1_failed_at} failed"
        else:
            verdict = fp8_c1_capacity_verdicts.get(ctx)
            if verdict in ("FAIL_OOM", "FAIL_CAPACITY", "FAIL_STARTUP", "FAIL_CRASH"):
                fp8_c1_failed_at = ctx
        plan.append(item)

    # 2. FP8 C4 32K (primary multi-agent point)
    fp8_c4_32k_item = {
        "kv_cache": KV_FP8,
        "concurrency": 4,
        "context": "32K",
        "status": "RUN",
        "reason": "primary multi-agent serving point",
    }
    if not fp8_available:
        fp8_c4_32k_item["status"] = "SKIP"
        fp8_c4_32k_item["reason"] = "FP8 E5M2 unsupported in pinned runtime/hardware"
    plan.append(fp8_c4_32k_item)

    # 3. FP8 C4 64K (mandatory comparison point)
    # Prerequisite: FP8 64K C1 Capacity PASS ∧ FP8 32K C4 Capacity PASS
    fp8_c4_64k_item = {
        "kv_cache": KV_FP8,
        "concurrency": 4,
        "context": "64K",
        "status": "RUN",
        "reason": "mandatory comparison point vs llama.cpp fallback and FP16 control",
    }
    if not fp8_available:
        fp8_c4_64k_item["status"] = "SKIP"
        fp8_c4_64k_item["reason"] = "FP8 E5M2 unsupported in pinned runtime/hardware"
    else:
        c1_64k_pass = (fp8_c1_capacity_verdicts.get("64K") == "PASS")
        c4_32k_pass = (fp8_c4_32k_capacity_verdict == "PASS")
        # Note: 32K C5 verdict is explicitly NOT a prerequisite for 64K C4!
        if not c1_64k_pass or not c4_32k_pass:
            fp8_c4_64k_item["status"] = "SKIP"
            reasons = []
            if not c1_64k_pass:
                reasons.append(f"FP8 64K C1 is {fp8_c1_capacity_verdicts.get('64K', 'NOT_PASS')}")
            if not c4_32k_pass:
                reasons.append(f"FP8 32K C4 is {fp8_c4_32k_capacity_verdict or 'NOT_PASS'}")
            fp8_c4_64k_item["reason"] = f"prerequisite unmet: {', '.join(reasons)}"
    plan.append(fp8_c4_64k_item)

    # 4. FP8 C5 32K (peak concurrency point)
    # Prerequisite: FP8 32K C4 Capacity PASS
    fp8_c5_32k_item = {
        "kv_cache": KV_FP8,
        "concurrency": 5,
        "context": "32K",
        "status": "RUN",
        "reason": "peak concurrency point",
    }
    if not fp8_available:
        fp8_c5_32k_item["status"] = "SKIP"
        fp8_c5_32k_item["reason"] = "FP8 E5M2 unsupported in pinned runtime/hardware"
    else:
        if fp8_c4_32k_capacity_verdict != "PASS":
            fp8_c5_32k_item["status"] = "SKIP"
            fp8_c5_32k_item["reason"] = f"prerequisite unmet: FP8 32K C4 is {fp8_c4_32k_capacity_verdict or 'NOT_PASS'}"
    plan.append(fp8_c5_32k_item)

    # 5. FP16 C1 128K (KV control point)
    # Independent of FP16 C4 64K
    fp16_c1_128k_item = {
        "kv_cache": KV_FP16,
        "concurrency": 1,
        "context": "128K",
        "status": "RUN",
        "reason": "independent KV control point vs FP8 C1 128K",
    }
    plan.append(fp16_c1_128k_item)

    # 6. FP16 C4 64K (KV control point)
    # Independent of FP16 C1 128K
    fp16_c4_64k_item = {
        "kv_cache": KV_FP16,
        "concurrency": 4,
        "context": "64K",
        "status": "RUN",
        "reason": "independent KV control point vs FP8 C4 64K & llama.cpp Fallback Profile",
    }
    plan.append(fp16_c4_64k_item)

    run_count = sum(1 for p in plan if p["status"] == "RUN")
    skip_count = sum(1 for p in plan if p["status"] == "SKIP")

    return {
        "planned_points": plan,
        "total_points": len(plan),
        "run_count": run_count,
        "skip_count": skip_count,
        "fp8_points": sum(1 for p in plan if p["kv_cache"] == KV_FP8),
        "fp16_points": sum(1 for p in plan if p["kv_cache"] == KV_FP16),
        "policy": {
            "measured_repetitions": 1,
            "full_size_warmup": 0,
            "speculation": SPECULATION,
            "dflash2": DFLASH2_STATUS,
        },
    }


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--plan-only", action="store_true", default=True,
                        help="Print offline execution plan JSON (never executes inference)")
    parser.add_argument("--fp8-unsupported", action="store_true",
                        help="Simulate FP8 unsupported condition")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    plan = evaluate_execution_plan(fp8_supported=not args.fp8_unsupported)
    print(json.dumps(plan, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Prometheus Prefix Cache Telemetry Collector for 1Cat-vLLM Phase 5.3."""

import argparse
import json
import re
import signal
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

TARGET_METRICS = [
    "vllm:prefix_cache_queries",
    "vllm:prefix_cache_hits",
    "vllm:num_requests_running",
    "vllm:num_requests_waiting",
    "vllm:gpu_cache_usage_factor",
    "vllm:prompt_tokens_total",
    "vllm:generation_tokens_total",
]

running = True

def handle_signal(signum, frame):
    global running
    running = False

signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, handle_signal)
signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, handle_signal)

def parse_prometheus_text(text: str) -> dict:
    metrics = {}
    for line in text.splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("#"):
            continue
        # match metric_name{labels} value or metric_name value
        m = re.match(r"^([a-zA-Z0-9_:]+)(?:\{[^}]*\})?\s+([0-9eE\+\-\.]+)", line)
        if m:
            name, val_str = m.group(1), m.group(2)
            for target in TARGET_METRICS:
                if name == target:
                    try:
                        metrics[target] = float(val_str)
                    except ValueError:
                        pass
    return metrics

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Prometheus Cache Telemetry Collector")
    parser.add_argument("--url", default="http://127.0.0.1:18080/metrics", help="Prometheus metrics URL")
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path, help="Output directory for telemetry")
    parser.add_argument("--interval", default=1.0, type=float, help="Collection interval in seconds")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    samples_file = args.output / "prometheus_cache_samples.jsonl"
    summary_file = args.output / "prometheus_cache.json"

    start_iso = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    start_mono = time.monotonic()
    samples = []

    with open(samples_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        while running:
            now_iso = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
            now_mono = time.monotonic()
            offset_s = now_mono - start_mono

            sample = {
                "timestamp": now_iso,
                "offset_s": offset_s,
                "metrics": {},
                "error": None
            }

            try:
                req = urllib.request.Request(args.url, method="GET")
                with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=2.0) as resp:
                    if resp.status == 200:
                        text = resp.read().decode("utf-8")
                        sample["metrics"] = parse_prometheus_text(text)
            except Exception as e:
                sample["error"] = str(e)

            f.write(json.dumps(sample) + "\n")
            f.flush()
            samples.append(sample)

            time.sleep(args.interval)

    end_iso = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    elapsed_s = time.monotonic() - start_mono

    # Compute deltas
    first_valid = next((s["metrics"] for s in samples if s["metrics"]), {})
    last_valid = next((s["metrics"] for s in reversed(samples) if s["metrics"]), {})

    initial_queries = first_valid.get("vllm:prefix_cache_queries", 0.0)
    final_queries = last_valid.get("vllm:prefix_cache_queries", 0.0)
    delta_queries = final_queries - initial_queries

    initial_hits = first_valid.get("vllm:prefix_cache_hits", 0.0)
    final_hits = last_valid.get("vllm:prefix_cache_hits", 0.0)
    delta_hits = final_hits - initial_hits

    hit_rate = (delta_hits / delta_queries) if delta_queries > 0 else 0.0

    max_running = max((s["metrics"].get("vllm:num_requests_running", 0.0) for s in samples if s["metrics"]), default=0.0)
    max_waiting = max((s["metrics"].get("vllm:num_requests_waiting", 0.0) for s in samples if s["metrics"]), default=0.0)
    max_cache_usage = max((s["metrics"].get("vllm:gpu_cache_usage_factor", 0.0) for s in samples if s["metrics"]), default=0.0)

    summary = {
        "started_at": start_iso,
        "ended_at": end_iso,
        "elapsed_seconds": elapsed_s,
        "sample_count": len(samples),
        "prefix_cache": {
            "initial_queries": initial_queries,

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run Pi E2E task for Phase 5 with precise wall timing and logging."""

import argparse
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

TASK_PROMPT = "ops/tasks/TASK-001.md를 pi-execute-task 스킬에 따라 수행하십시오."


def run_pi(experiment_id, model_id, workspace_dir, raw_dir, *, agent_dir=None,
           thinking=None, prompt=TASK_PROMPT, timeout_seconds=None):
    raw_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    session_log_path = raw_dir / "session.log"
    timing_json_path = raw_dir / "timing.json"

    java_home = "/usr/lib/jvm/java-1.21.0-openjdk-amd64"
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env["JAVA_HOME"] = java_home
    env["PATH"] = f"{java_home}/bin:{env.get('PATH', '')}"
    if agent_dir is not None:
        env["PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR"] = str(agent_dir)

    cmd = [
        "/home/loopwhile/.npm-global/bin/pi",
        "--approve",
        "-p",
        prompt,
        "--model",
        model_id,
    ]
    if thinking is not None:
        cmd += ["--thinking", thinking, "--session-dir", str(raw_dir / "sessions")]

    print(f"[{datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}] Starting Pi E2E task in {workspace_dir}")
    print(f"Command: {' '.join(cmd)}")

    start_time_iso = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    start_time_mono = time.monotonic()

    with open(session_log_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as log_file:
        proc = subprocess.Popen(
            cmd,
            cwd=workspace_dir,
            env=env,
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
            text=True,
            bufsize=1,
            start_new_session=True,
        )

        # A timer bounds one invocation without replaying a failed TASK.
        import signal
        import threading
        def terminate():
            if proc.poll() is None:
                os.killpg(proc.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
        timer = threading.Timer(timeout_seconds, terminate) if timeout_seconds else None
        if timer:
            timer.start()

        for line in proc.stdout:
            sys.stdout.write(line)
            sys.stdout.flush()
            log_file.write(line)
            log_file.flush()

        proc.wait()
        if timer:
            timer.cancel()
        exit_code = proc.returncode

    end_time_iso = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    end_time_mono = time.monotonic()
    wall_time_s = end_time_mono - start_time_mono

    print(f"\n[{datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}] Pi E2E task finished with exit code {exit_code}")
    print(f"Wall time: {wall_time_s:.2f} seconds")

    timing_data = {
        "experiment_id": experiment_id,
        "start_time_iso": start_time_iso,
        "end_time_iso": end_time_iso,
        "wall_time_s": wall_time_s,
        "exit_code": exit_code,
    }

    with open(timing_json_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(timing_data, f, indent=2)

    return exit_code


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Run Pi E2E task for Phase 5")
    parser.add_argument("--experiment-id", help="Historical runner experiment ID")
    parser.add_argument("--model", default="llama-cpp/Qwen3.8-27B-32K")
    parser.add_argument("--config", type=Path, help="Supplementary config; defaults to offline validation")
    parser.add_argument("--execute", action="store_true", help="Explicit future GPU/Pi execution opt-in")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.config:
        if args.experiment_id or args.model != "llama-cpp/Qwen3.8-27B-32K":
            parser.error("--config selects the frozen experiment and exact model; do not override")
        from phase5_supplementary import execute, validate
        return execute(args.config) if args.execute else validate(args.config)
    if args.execute or not args.experiment_id:
        parser.error("--experiment-id or --config is required; --execute requires --config")
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    experiment_id = args.experiment_id.strip()
    return run_pi(experiment_id, args.model.strip(), root / "e2e" / experiment_id,
                  root / "results/raw" / experiment_id)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'scripts'))
import phase3_concurrency as p
from phase3_finalize import finalize

class Phase3Tests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_finalizer_maps_task_counters_and_preserves_originals(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            out=Path(d)
            fixture={'requests.json':[{'request_id':'measured-1-req-01','slot_id':0,
                'submitted_s':0,'terminal_s':3,'decode_tps':20,'raw_prompt_sha256':'tokens'}],
                'metrics.json':{'batches':[{}],'capacity_verdict':'INCONCLUSIVE'},
                'config.json':{},'experiment-plan.json':{'workload':{'case':{'messages':[]}}}}
            for name,value in fixture.items(): (out/name).write_text(json.dumps(value))
            (out/'measured-1').mkdir()
            (out/'measured-1/slots.jsonl').write_text(json.dumps({'at_s':1,'slots':[
                {'id':0,'id_task':5,'is_processing':True,'next_token':[{'n_decoded':5}]}]})+'\n')
            (out/'server.log').write_text('slot print_timing: id  0 | task 5 | draft acceptance = 0.50000 ( 10 accepted / 20 generated), mean len = 2.50\n')
            finalize(out); finalize(out)
            r=json.loads((out/'requests.json').read_text())[0]
            self.assertEqual(r['acceptance_rate'],.5)
            self.assertEqual(r['accepted_length'],2.5)
            self.assertEqual(r['token_ids_sha256'],'tokens')
            self.assertEqual(json.loads((out/'runner-requests.json').read_text()),fixture['requests.json'])
    def test_plan_matrix(self):
        for kv in ('f16','q8_0'):
            for c in (1,4,5):
                plan=p.build_plan(ROOT,kv,c)
                cmd=plan['command']; cfg=plan['configs'][0]
                self.assertEqual(cmd[cmd.index('--ctx-size')+1],str(c*32768))
                self.assertEqual(cmd[cmd.index('--parallel')+1],str(c))
                self.assertIn('@sha256:',cfg['image_digest'])
                self.assertEqual(cfg['repetition_count'],3)
                self.assertFalse(cfg['cache_prompt'])
                self.assertEqual(cfg['requested_output_tokens'],512)
                self.assertIn('run='+plan['group'],cmd)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): p.build_plan(ROOT,'f16',2)
    def test_plan_frontier_wbs32(self):
        plan_64k = p.build_plan(ROOT, 'q8_0', 4, ctx_size=65536, spec='mtp')
        self.assertEqual(plan_64k['configs'][0]['context_tokens'], 65536)
        self.assertEqual(plan_64k['configs'][0]['server_context_pool_tokens'], 65536 * 4)
        self.assertIn('--ctx-size', plan_64k['command'])
        self.assertEqual(plan_64k['command'][plan_64k['command'].index('--ctx-size')+1], str(65536 * 4))
        self.assertIn('--parallel', plan_64k['command'])
        self.assertEqual(plan_64k['command'][plan_64k['command'].index('--parallel')+1], '4')
        self.assertIn('--spec-type', plan_64k['command'])
        self.assertEqual(plan_64k['command'][plan_64k['command'].index('--spec-type')+1], 'draft-mtp')

        plan_target = p.build_plan(ROOT, 'q8_0', 4, ctx_size=65536, spec='none')
        self.assertEqual(plan_target['command'][plan_target['command'].index('--spec-type')+1], 'none')
        self.assertIn('-NONE-', plan_target['configs'][0]['experiment_id'])
    def test_overlap_rejects_reserved_idle_and_nonprogressing(self):
        records=[{'slot_id':i,'submitted_s':0,'terminal_s':10} for i in range(5)]
        def sample(t,n):
            return {'at_s':t,'slots':[{'id':i,'id_task':10+i,'is_processing':True,'next_token':{'n_decoded':n}} for i in range(5)]}
        self.assertFalse(p.overlap_evidence([sample(1,0),sample(2,0)],records)['proven'])
        self.assertFalse(p.overlap_evidence([sample(1,2),sample(2,2)],records)['proven'])
        self.assertTrue(p.overlap_evidence([sample(1,2),sample(2,6)],records)['proven'])
        array_samples=[sample(1,2),sample(2,6)]
        for s in array_samples:
            for slot in s['slots']:
                slot['next_token']=[slot['next_token']]
        self.assertTrue(p.overlap_evidence(array_samples,records)['proven'])
        stale=[sample(11,2),sample(12,6)]
        self.assertFalse(p.overlap_evidence(stale,records)['proven'])
    def test_metrics_preserve_failure_and_exact_token_numerator(self):
        records=[{'verdict':'PASS','submitted_s':0,'terminal_s':10,'actual_output_tokens':6,
                  'token_events':[{'at_s':2,'tokens':[1,2,3]},{'at_s':4,'tokens':[4,5,6]}]},
                 {'verdict':'PASS','submitted_s':.01,'terminal_s':12,'actual_output_tokens':4,
                  'token_events':[{'at_s':3,'tokens':[1,2]},{'at_s':5,'tokens':[3,4]}]}]
        m=p.batch_metrics(records,{'proven':True},True)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(m['aggregate_decode_tps'],7/3)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(m['end_to_end_output_tps'],10/12)
        self.assertEqual(p.batch_metrics(records,{'proven':False},True)['verdict'],'INCONCLUSIVE')
        records[1]['verdict']='FAIL_TIMEOUT'
        m=p.batch_metrics(records,{'proven':True},True)
        self.assertEqual(m['completed_requests'],1)
        self.assertEqual(m['verdict'],'FAIL_TIMEOUT')
        self.assertIsNone(m['aggregate_decode_tps'])
    def test_sse_exact_tokens_and_partial_failure(self):
        chunk={'content':'Readable generated text.','tokens':list(range(512)),'stop':False}
        final={'stop':True,'tokens_predicted':512,'tokens_evaluated':3,'timings':{'predicted_n':512,'cache_n':0}}
        def response(chunks): return io.BytesIO(b''.join(b'data: '+json.dumps(x).encode()+b'\n\n' for x in chunks))
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
            adapter=p.HTTPAdapter('http://invalid','llama.cpp')
            with patch('urllib.request.urlopen',return_value=response([chunk,final])):
                r=p.stream_request(adapter,{'prompt':[1,2,3]}, {},Path(td)/'valid')
                self.assertEqual(r['verdict'],'PASS')
                self.assertEqual(r['stream_token_count'],512)
                self.assertIsNone(r['itl_ms'])
            with patch('urllib.request.urlopen',return_value=response([chunk])):
                r=p.stream_request(adapter,{'prompt':[1,2,3]}, {},Path(td)/'partial')
                self.assertNotEqual(r['verdict'],'PASS')
                self.assertEqual(r['actual_output_tokens'],512)
            with patch('urllib.request.urlopen',return_value=response([chunk,dict(final,tokens_evaluated=2)])):
                r=p.stream_request(adapter,{'prompt':[1,2,3]}, {},Path(td)/'wrong-budget')
                self.assertEqual(r['verdict'],'FAIL_CAPACITY')

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Offline unit tests for Phase 4 execution plan and matrix validation.

Verifies the 10 core constraints without touching any GPU or network:
1. Normal prerequisite performance matrix has exactly 9 points.
2. FP8 points = 7.
3. FP16 points = 2.
4. No duplicate points in the matrix.
5. No forbidden extra matrix points generated.
6. repetition = 1 for all configurations.
7. full-size warmup = 0 for all configurations.
8. FP8 32K C5 failure does NOT auto-skip 64K C4 (prerequisite independence).
9. FP16 C1 128K and C4 64K are independent controls.
10. If FP8 is unsupported, FP8 performance matrix is not auto-executed.
"""
import unittest
from scripts.phase4_plan import (
    evaluate_execution_plan,
    get_base_matrix,
    FORBIDDEN_POINTS,
    KV_FP8,
    KV_FP16,
)


class TestPhase4Plan(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_01_normal_matrix_exactly_nine_points(self):
        """1. 정상 prerequisite 상태의 performance matrix가 정확히 9개인지 검증."""
        matrix = get_base_matrix()
        self.assertEqual(len(matrix), 9)

        # Plan evaluation with all prerequisites passed
        plan = evaluate_execution_plan(
            fp8_supported=True,
            fp8_c1_capacity_verdicts={"32K": "PASS", "64K": "PASS", "96K": "PASS", "128K": "PASS"},
            fp8_c4_32k_capacity_verdict="PASS",
            fp8_c5_32k_capacity_verdict="PASS",
            fp16_c1_128k_capacity_verdict="PASS",
            fp16_c4_64k_capacity_verdict="PASS",
        )
        self.assertEqual(plan["total_points"], 9)
        self.assertEqual(plan["run_count"], 9)
        self.assertEqual(plan["skip_count"], 0)

    def test_02_fp8_points_count(self):
        """2. FP8 point = 7개인지 검증."""
        matrix = get_base_matrix()
        fp8_points = [p for p in matrix if p["kv_cache"] == KV_FP8]
        self.assertEqual(len(fp8_points), 7)

    def test_03_fp16_points_count(self):
        """3. FP16 point = 2개인지 검증."""
        matrix = get_base_matrix()
        fp16_points = [p for p in matrix if p["kv_cache"] == KV_FP16]
        self.assertEqual(len(fp16_points), 2)

    def test_04_no_duplicates(self):
        """4. 중복 점이 없는지 검증."""
        matrix = get_base_matrix()
        seen = set()
        for p in matrix:
            key = (p["kv_cache"], p["context"], p["concurrency"])
            self.assertNotIn(key, seen, f"Duplicate matrix point found: {key}")
            seen.add(key)
        self.assertEqual(len(seen), 9)

    def test_05_no_forbidden_extra_matrix(self):
        """5. 금지된 extra matrix 생성이 없는지 검증."""
        matrix = get_base_matrix()
        for p in matrix:
            key = (p["kv_cache"], p["context"], p["concurrency"])
            self.assertNotIn(key, FORBIDDEN_POINTS, f"Forbidden point in base matrix: {key}")

    def test_06_measured_repetitions_is_one(self):
        """6. repetition = 1 정책 유지 검증."""
        matrix = get_base_matrix()
        for p in matrix:
            self.assertEqual(p.get("measured_repetitions"), 1,
                             f"measured_repetitions != 1 for {p}")

        plan = evaluate_execution_plan()
        self.assertEqual(plan["policy"]["measured_repetitions"], 1)

    def test_07_full_size_warmup_is_zero(self):
        """7. full-size warmup = 0 정책 유지 검증."""
        matrix = get_base_matrix()
        for p in matrix:
            self.assertEqual(p.get("full_size_warmup"), 0,
                             f"full_size_warmup != 0 for {p}")

        plan = evaluate_execution_plan()
        self.assertEqual(plan["policy"]["full_size_warmup"], 0)

    def test_08_c5_failure_does_not_skip_64k_c4(self):
        """8. 32K C5 failure가 64K C4를 자동 skip하지 않음을 검증."""
        # Condition: 64K C1 PASS, 32K C4 PASS, but 32K C5 FAIL_OOM
        plan = evaluate_execution_plan(
            fp8_supported=True,
            fp8_c1_capacity_verdicts={"32K": "PASS", "64K": "PASS"},
            fp8_c4_32k_capacity_verdict="PASS",
            fp8_c5_32k_capacity_verdict="FAIL_OOM",  # C5 fails!
        )
        planned = { (p["kv_cache"], p["context"], p["concurrency"]): p["status"]
                    for p in plan["planned_points"] }

        # 64K C4 must still be RUN because prerequisites (64K C1 PASS ∧ 32K C4 PASS) are met!
        self.assertEqual(planned[(KV_FP8, "64K", 4)], "RUN",
                         "FP8 64K C4 must not be skipped when only 32K C5 fails")

    def test_09_fp16_controls_are_independent(self):
        """9. FP16 C1 128K / C4 64K가 서로 독립 control임을 검증."""
        # Case A: C1 128K fails, C4 64K should still run
        plan_a = evaluate_execution_plan(
            fp8_supported=True,
            fp16_c1_128k_capacity_verdict="FAIL_OOM",
        )
        planned_a = { (p["kv_cache"], p["context"], p["concurrency"]): p["status"]
                      for p in plan_a["planned_points"] }
        self.assertEqual(planned_a[(KV_FP16, "64K", 4)], "RUN",
                         "FP16 C4 64K should remain RUN even if FP16 C1 128K fails")

        # Case B: C4 64K fails, C1 128K should still run
        plan_b = evaluate_execution_plan(
            fp8_supported=True,
            fp16_c4_64k_capacity_verdict="FAIL_OOM",
        )
        planned_b = { (p["kv_cache"], p["context"], p["concurrency"]): p["status"]
                      for p in plan_b["planned_points"] }
        self.assertEqual(planned_b[(KV_FP16, "128K", 1)], "RUN",
                         "FP16 C1 128K should remain RUN even if FP16 C4 64K fails")

    def test_10_fp8_unsupported_skips_fp8_matrix(self):
        """10. FP8 unsupported 시 FP8 performance matrix가 자동 실행되지 않음을 검증."""
        plan = evaluate_execution_plan(fp8_supported=False)
        for p in plan["planned_points"]:
            if p["kv_cache"] == KV_FP8:
                self.assertEqual(p["status"], "SKIP",
                                 f"FP8 point {p} must be SKIP when FP8 unsupported")
                self.assertIn("unsupported", p["reason"].lower())
            elif p["kv_cache"] == KV_FP16:
                # FP16 controls can still run
                self.assertEqual(p["status"], "RUN",
                                 f"FP16 point {p} should still RUN when FP8 unsupported")

    def test_fp8_c1_fail_fast(self):
        """Supplementary test: FP8 C1 fail-fast skips higher contexts."""
        # 32K fails -> 64K, 96K, 128K skip
        plan = evaluate_execution_plan(
            fp8_supported=True,
            fp8_c1_capacity_verdicts={"32K": "FAIL_OOM"},
        )
        planned = { (p["kv_cache"], p["context"], p["concurrency"]): p["status"]
                    for p in plan["planned_points"] }
        self.assertEqual(planned[(KV_FP8, "32K", 1)], "RUN")
        self.assertEqual(planned[(KV_FP8, "64K", 1)], "SKIP")
        self.assertEqual(planned[(KV_FP8, "96K", 1)], "SKIP")
        self.assertEqual(planned[(KV_FP8, "128K", 1)], "SKIP")
        # And 64K C4 also skips because 64K C1 did not pass
        self.assertEqual(planned[(KV_FP8, "64K", 4)], "SKIP")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td, patch('socket.gethostname', return_value='offline-test'):

    def test_historical_r1_runner_disabled_without_required_c1_probe(self):
        # The executed R1 config is historical evidence. It must not be reused for another GPU run.
        with patch('socket.gethostname', return_value='p520-llm'):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'lacks required C1 agent-loop compatibility probe'):
                runner.execute(pc.ROOT, 'WBS 4.5.1 retry 진행.')

    def test_failed_scrape_retained(self):
        adapter = HTTPAdapter('http://unused', '1Cat-vLLM')

            row = runner.snapshot(adapter, 'test')
        self.assertEqual(row['metrics'], [])
        self.assertIn('missing scrape', row['error'])
        self.assertGreaterEqual(row['at_s'], row['started_s'])

    def test_failed_loop_offline_recovery_and_duplicate_guard(self):
        # Actual interrupted-finalizer evidence: four corrupt outputs, sixteen unsubmitted.
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
            root = Path(td)
            for directory in ('config', 'workloads'):
                shutil.copytree(pc.ROOT / directory, root / directory)
            hist_id = 'EXP-Q38-1CAT-NVFP4-FP8E5M2-NONE-C4-32K-4511'
            raw = root / 'results/raw' / hist_id

            for path in ('results/summary.csv', 'reports/comparison.csv'):
                (root / path).write_text((pc.ROOT / path).read_text().splitlines()[0] + '\n')
            with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()), patch('socket.socket', side_effect=AssertionError('no network')):
                finalizer.finalize(root, hist_id)
            result = json.loads((raw / 'finalized-metrics.json').read_text())

set -euo pipefail

EXP_ID="EXP-Q38-PI-1CAT-NVFP4-FP8E5M2-NONE-C4-32K-PCACHE-TASK001-531"
REPO_ROOT="/home/loopwhile/Data/Workspace_VSCode/qwen3.8-bench"
RAW_DIR="${REPO_ROOT}/results/raw/${EXP_ID}"
WORKSPACE_DIR="${REPO_ROOT}/e2e/${EXP_ID}"

echo "[$(date -u +%FT%TZ)] Starting Phase 5.3.1 Measured E2E Execution: ${EXP_ID}"

mkdir -p "${RAW_DIR}"

# 1. Start Prometheus cache collector in background
echo "[$(date -u +%FT%TZ)] Starting Prometheus cache collector..."
python3 "${REPO_ROOT}/scripts/prometheus_cache_collector.py" \
  --output "${RAW_DIR}" \
  --interval 1.0 &
PROMETHEUS_PID=$!
echo "Prometheus collector PID: ${PROMETHEUS_PID}"

# 2. Start GPU telemetry on P520 in background
echo "[$(date -u +%FT%TZ)] Starting GPU telemetry on P520..."
ssh p520 'rm -rf /home/loopwhile/qwen3.8-bench-runtime/telemetry_531 && /home/loopwhile/qwen3.8-bench-runtime/venv/bin/python /home/loopwhile/qwen3.8-bench-runtime/scripts/gpu_telemetry.py --target-host p520-llm --output /home/loopwhile/qwen3.8-bench-runtime/telemetry_531 --phase measurement --duration-s 1800 --interval-s 1.0' &
GPU_TELEMETRY_PID=$!
echo "GPU telemetry SSH PID: ${GPU_TELEMETRY_PID}"

sleep 2

# 3. Run Pi Coding-Agent E2E task
echo "[$(date -u +%FT%TZ)] Running Pi Coding-Agent E2E..."
set +e
python3 "${REPO_ROOT}/scripts/run_phase5_pi.py" \
  --experiment-id "${EXP_ID}" \
  --model "vllm/Qwen3.8-27B"
PI_EXIT_CODE=$?
set -e
echo "[$(date -u +%FT%TZ)] Pi execution finished with exit code: ${PI_EXIT_CODE}"

# 4. Stop collectors
echo "[$(date -u +%FT%TZ)] Stopping Prometheus collector..."
kill -INT "${PROMETHEUS_PID}" 2>/dev/null || true
wait "${PROMETHEUS_PID}" 2>/dev/null || true

echo "[$(date -u +%FT%TZ)] Stopping GPU telemetry on P520..."
ssh p520 'pkill -INT -f "gpu_telemetry.py.*telemetry_531" || true'
wait "${GPU_TELEMETRY_PID}" 2>/dev/null || true

# 5. Fetch GPU telemetry from P520
echo "[$(date -u +%FT%TZ)] Fetching GPU telemetry files..."
scp -r "p520:/home/loopwhile/qwen3.8-bench-runtime/telemetry_531/*" "${RAW_DIR}/" || true

# Convert telemetry samples to telemetry.csv for dual CSV compatibility
python3 -c "
import json, csv, sys
from pathlib import Path
raw_dir = Path('${RAW_DIR}')
samples_file = raw_dir / 'samples.jsonl'
csv_file = raw_dir / 'telemetry.csv'
if samples_file.exists():
    with open(samples_file, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f_in, open(csv_file, 'w', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f_out:
        writer = csv.writer(f_out)
        writer.writerow(['timestamp', 'slot', 'phase', 'gpu_index', 'gpu_uuid', 'memory_used_mib', 'power_w', 'temperature_c', 'sm_clock_mhz', 'utilization_pct'])
        for line in f_in:
            if not line.strip(): continue
            d = json.loads(line)
            ts = d.get('observed_at_utc', '')
            slot = d.get('slot', 0)
            phase = d.get('phase', '')
            for g in d.get('gpus', []):
                idx = g.get('index', 0)
                uuid = g.get('uuid', '')
                m = g.get('metrics', {})
                writer.writerow([ts, slot, phase, idx, uuid, m.get('memory_used_mib'), m.get('power_w'), m.get('temperature_c'), m.get('sm_clock_mhz'), m.get('utilization_pct')])
" || true

# 6. Post-health check
echo "[$(date -u +%FT%TZ)] Checking post-run server health..."
curl -i http://127.0.0.1:18080/health > "${RAW_DIR}/post_health.txt" 2>&1 || true

# 7. Fetch server log from P520
echo "[$(date -u +%FT%TZ)] Fetching server log from P520..."
scp "p520:/home/loopwhile/qwen3.8-bench-runtime/vllm_measured.log" "${RAW_DIR}/server.log" || true

# 8. Safely stop 1Cat-vLLM server on P520
echo "[$(date -u +%FT%TZ)] Stopping 1Cat-vLLM server on P520..."
ssh p520 'pkill -f vllm || true'

# 9. Extract Git artifacts from workspace
echo "[$(date -u +%FT%TZ)] Extracting Git artifacts..."
cd "${WORKSPACE_DIR}"
git status --porcelain > "${RAW_DIR}/changed_files.txt" 2>&1 || true
git log -n 1 --pretty=format:"commit %H%nAuthor: %an <%ae>%nDate: %ad%n%n%s%n%b" > "${RAW_DIR}/final_commit.txt" 2>&1 || true
git diff main HEAD > "${RAW_DIR}/patch.diff" 2>&1 || true
cp "${WORKSPACE_DIR}/workspace_info.json" "${RAW_DIR}/workspace_info.json" 2>/dev/null || true

# Copy Pi session file if available
PI_SESSION_DIR="/home/loopwhile/.pi/agent/sessions/--home-loopwhile-Data-Workspace_VSCode-qwen3.8-bench-e2e-${EXP_ID}--"
if [ -d "${PI_SESSION_DIR}" ]; then
  echo "[$(date -u +%FT%TZ)] Found Pi session directory: ${PI_SESSION_DIR}"
  cp "${PI_SESSION_DIR}"/*.jsonl "${RAW_DIR}/session.jsonl" 2>/dev/null || true
fi

# 10. Run independent external evaluator
echo "[$(date -u +%FT%TZ)] Running independent external evaluator..."
cd "${REPO_ROOT}"
python3 "${REPO_ROOT}/scripts/phase5_evaluator.py" \
  --workspace-dir "${WORKSPACE_DIR}" \
  --experiment-id "${EXP_ID}" \
  --output-dir "${RAW_DIR}" || true

echo "[$(date -u +%FT%TZ)] Phase 5.3.1 Measured E2E Execution Completed."

# v100-llm-test

Final serving acceptance tests for a Lenovo P520 with 2× Tesla V100 16GB.

## Goal

Determine which model/runtime/topology can reliably serve independent single-agent coding projects with:
- per-agent context ceiling: 128K
- normal concurrency: C1
- required peak concurrency: C2
- C3+ out of scope
- C2 requests are independent projects, not cooperating agents

A server merely configured for 128K is not a 128K PASS. Two accepted HTTP requests are not automatically an active C2 PASS.

## Candidate models
- Qwen3.8-27B
- Ornith 1.5 35B-A3B
- Ornith 1.5 9B
- Gemma4 26B-A4B

## Required runtime lanes

llama.cpp:
Global llama.cpp lane catalog:
- TARGET
- NGRAM
- MTP
- MTP_NGRAM

TARGET versus NGRAM is mandatory for every llama.cpp candidate. MTP versus MTP_NGRAM applies only to model artifacts that explicitly declare the MTP pair. Qwen3.8-27B intentionally uses TARGET + NGRAM only; Ornith/Gemma candidates retain the MTP pair.

vLLM family:
- 1Cat-vLLM STOCK
- v100-skinny SKINNY, mandatory explicit result row

v100-skinny is a separate pinned runtime identity, not a flag on the STOCK 1Cat environment. On the current 2×V100-16GB P520, WBS 1.4 ends at `FAIL_OOM_MODEL_LOAD` during QPN prepack before server boot, so SKINNY is retained as evidence but not scheduled for C1/C2.

## Topologies
- tp2-shared: one model/server across both V100s
- 1gpu-x2-independent: two one-GPU Ornith 1.5 9B servers behind one **mandatory LiteLLM gateway**; a first-class candidate for llama.cpp and, once the exact artifact is verified, STOCK 1Cat-vLLM

For `1gpu-x2-independent`, both C1 and C2 acceptance requests must enter through the same LiteLLM endpoint. Direct client-to-backend routing is diagnostic only and cannot produce the final topology acceptance result. LiteLLM is pinned to v1.101.0 and uses a two-deployment model group with `least-busy` routing and `max_parallel_requests=1` per backend.

Shared llama.cpp C2 explicitly requests a 256K logical aggregate KV pool with a 128K ceiling per slot.

## Workloads
Compact deterministic manifests:
- workloads/capacity/v1.json
- workloads/concurrency/v1.json
- workloads/performance/v1.json

scripts/build_128k_workload.py materializes them with the exact live tokenizer so prompt plus reserved output stays within 131072 tokens while filling at least 99% of the budget.

C2 uses unrelated Project A and Project B material with distinct hashes. Capacity/C2 reserve 2048 output tokens and require at least 256 actual completion tokens. The performance workload reserves 4096 and requires at least 1024; it diversifies repeated identifiers so NGRAM performance is not dominated by trivial exact repetition.

## Evidence
Fresh runs write raw evidence under results/raw/<EXPERIMENT_ID>/, one Markdown report under reports/, and normalized rows in:
- results/summary.csv
- reports/comparison.csv

Historical results are not imported as acceptance evidence. C2 evidence is sampled from runtime metrics/slots during the measured window, and sampled peak VRAM is merged into the experiment metrics. For Ornith 9B 1GPU×2, evidence additionally records LiteLLM deployment headers and backend activity so the result proves that the single gateway actually distributed the two active requests across GPU0/GPU1.

# Methodology

## Mission

Find a practical final serving configuration for independent single-agent coding projects on 2× Tesla V100 16GB.

Operating pattern:
- C1 normally
- C2 occasionally
- C3+ out of scope
- 128K target per agent

## Measurement order
1. Fresh runtime/model/artifact compatibility.
2. C1 128K capacity/correctness for every required lane.
3. C2 128K residency/active overlap for C1 survivors, proven with runtime-side overlap evidence.
4. Ornith 9B 1GPU×2 + LiteLLM end-to-end serving topology.
5. Performance comparisons inside valid configurations.
6. Final operational selection.

Do not broaden into large context sweeps. 96K/64K is diagnostic only after a clear 128K capacity failure.

## Fresh evidence

Historical repositories are implementation references only. One experiment has one immutable ID, config identity, raw directory and final report. Retries use new IDs.

## Correctness before performance

Performance is valid only after the exact configuration produces valid output and remains healthy.

## C2 meaning

C2 is two independent projects released through a common barrier with different prompt material and hashes. Shared-server PASS_C2_ACTIVE requires sampled server state consistent with two running/processing requests during the overlapping decode window; client sockets alone are insufficient. For Ornith 9B 1GPU×2, both requests must enter through the same LiteLLM endpoint and the evidence must show that both one-GPU backends participated; direct per-request backend routing is not an acceptance test.

Verdicts include:
- PASS_C1_128K
- PASS_C2_RESIDENT
- PASS_C2_ACTIVE
- QUEUE_ONLY
- FAIL_STARTUP
- FAIL_OOM
- FAIL_CAPACITY
- FAIL_TIMEOUT
- FAIL_CRASH
- FAIL_OUTPUT
- UNSUPPORTED
- INCONCLUSIVE

QUEUE_ONLY is not PASS_C2_ACTIVE.

## Metrics

Keep TTFT, ITL, prefill throughput, request decode throughput, aggregate decode throughput, end-to-end output throughput, request/batch wall time and GPU telemetry distinct. Never label all of them simply tok/s. Sustained C2 comparisons use workloads/performance/v1.json (4K reserved output, >=1K actual output, diversified identifiers), while capacity acceptance uses the shorter 2K/256-token objective.

## Repetition and warmup

Default to one measured execution per configuration unless explicitly authorized otherwise. Readiness/JIT probes are allowed; duplicate full 128K warmups require a documented reason.

## Required lanes

llama.cpp uses TARGET, NGRAM, MTP and MTP_NGRAM. TARGET versus NGRAM is mandatory. MTP and MTP_NGRAM remain explicit rows even when UNSUPPORTED.

For C1/C2, NGRAM is an acceptance/compatibility lane: prove that the declared NGRAM configuration starts, remains healthy, preserves output integrity, and meets the requested context/concurrency capacity. Draft/accepted-token activity or a throughput gain is not required for C1/C2 PASS. NGRAM performance effectiveness is evaluated only in Phase 5 with the sustained performance workload.

STOCK 1Cat and v100-skinny are separate mandatory backend rows.

LiteLLM v1.101.0 is a mandatory measured component of the Ornith 9B 1GPU×2 topology. Its routing overhead is intentionally included in end-to-end TTFT and throughput for that topology.

## Hardware policy

Benchmark scripts observe but do not change power limits, clocks, persistence, drivers, kernel or CPU power policy.

# Runtime Lanes

Turn 4 exposes mandatory serving lanes. A launch plan is not a capacity PASS.

## llama.cpp

Every llama.cpp candidate has four explicit rows:

| Lane | Configuration | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| TARGET | \`--spec-type none\` | yes |
| NGRAM | \`--spec-type ngram-simple\` | yes |
| MTP | \`--spec-type draft-mtp\` + model-profile draft contract | explicit result row |
| MTP_NGRAM | \`--spec-type draft-mtp,ngram-simple\` + model-profile draft contract | explicit result row |

TARGET↔NGRAM is mandatory even when MTP is not usable. Unsupported MTP/composite support is recorded as \`UNSUPPORTED\`, not deleted.

For C1/C2, the NGRAM requirement is operational compatibility/capacity: the lane must launch with \`ngram-simple\`, survive the requested context/concurrency, preserve output integrity, and remain healthy. Draft/accepted-token activity and TARGET-relative acceleration are not C1/C2 acceptance gates. Those are Phase 5 performance questions.

### 128K topology

Shared TP2 C1 uses \`--ctx-size 131072 --parallel 1 --kv-unified --kv-unified-per-slot 131072\`.

Shared TP2 C2 uses \`--ctx-size 262144 --parallel 2 --kv-unified --kv-unified-per-slot 131072\`. The launcher also enables the slots endpoint so C2 residency/processing can be sampled during the run.

The C2 value intentionally asks for two independent 128K logical contexts. If it does not fit, preserve the OOM/capacity result.

\`1gpu-x2-independent\` starts two separate C1/128K Ornith 9B servers, one on each GPU, **plus a mandatory LiteLLM gateway**. Both C1 and C2 measured requests enter through the single gateway endpoint; direct backend selection is diagnostic only.

## Skinny TP2 boot gate

If a future hardware/configuration change reaches server boot and the compatibility warm request, run:

```bash

```

The TP2 census expectation is **256** protected FP8 module instances (128 per rank × 2 ranks), not the upstream TP4 script's hard-coded 512. The gate also requires the requested MTP depth, lm_head QPN route, no repack fallback, declined checkpoint FP8-KV directive, zero scalar-paged calls, XQA, QPN2 and QPN8 dispatch.


## LiteLLM gateway for Ornith 9B 1GPU×2

The independent topology pins LiteLLM v1.101.0 (`18243cd7af4c3325165ba68b21379e2719e051c7`) as part of the measured serving stack.

- one client endpoint: `http://127.0.0.1:18079`
- two local OpenAI-compatible deployments: backend ports 18080/18081
- routing: `least-busy`
- `max_parallel_requests=1` per deployment
- backend `timeout=1800`, `stream_timeout=1800`, `max_retries=0`
- router `num_retries=0` so hidden retries do not mask routing/capacity failures
- no context-window pre-call filter is enabled at the gateway; the backend/live-tokenizer acceptance remains authoritative for the exact 128K budget
- request-level `chat_template_kwargs` (including `enable_thinking=false`) are forwarded through LiteLLM as OpenAI `extra_body`, keeping the gateway request aligned with the direct backend tokenization receipt
- C1 and C2 both include the gateway
- LiteLLM response headers `x-litellm-model-id` and `x-litellm-model-api-base` are recorded when present
- backend runtime metrics remain the authoritative corroboration that both GPU servers were active
- gateway readiness evidence uses `/health/liveliness`; generic LiteLLM `/health` is not used because it can actively health-check configured model deployments and would contaminate a no-warmup acceptance run

The generated LiteLLM config and `gateway.log` are preserved in the experiment runtime directory.

This repository compares pinned V100/SM70 serving lanes. Mutable labels such as latest may be used for discovery, but not as the benchmark identity.

- MTP — native MTP
- MTP_NGRAM — native MTP plus ngram

TARGET versus NGRAM is mandatory. MTP versus MTP_NGRAM is also preserved as an explicit support/result pair. Unsupported exact model/build combinations are recorded as UNSUPPORTED, never silently deleted or source-patched into a different benchmark.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""One bounded, detached-safe WBS 2.1.1 run. Never retries or changes lanes."""
import argparse
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shlex
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time

import bench_harness as h
import build_128k_workload as w
import runtime_launcher as launcher
from measurement_policy import future_config

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

def command(args, timeout=30):
    return subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout, check=True).stdout


def checkpoint(raw, phase, **extra):
    path = raw / 'runtime/progress.json'
    state = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.exists() else {}
    h.save(path, state | dict(phase=phase, updated_at_utc=h.utc(), **extra))


def measure(raw):
    config = json.loads((raw / 'runtime/planned-config.json').read_text())
    adapter = h.HTTPAdapter(config['endpoint'], 'llama.cpp', timeout_s=1800)
    checkpoint(raw, 'running', step='materializing_live_tokenizer_workload')
    workload = w.build(w.load_manifest(ROOT / 'workloads/capacity/v1.json'), adapter, config['model'])
    checkpoint(raw, 'running', step='measured_request', workload_sha256=h.sha(h.canon(workload)))
    verdict = h.run_batch(raw, config, workload, adapter)
    checkpoint(raw, 'results_saved', step='measurement_complete', verdict=verdict)


def run(args):
    if socket.gethostname().split('.')[0] != 'p520-llm':
        raise RuntimeError('requires p520-llm')
    lock_path = ROOT / 'results/experiment.lock'
    lock_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with lock_path.open('a+') as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        return run_locked(args)


def run_locked(args):
    raw = ROOT / 'results/raw' / args.experiment_id
    raw.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    runtime = raw / 'runtime'
    runtime.mkdir()
    plan = launcher.build_plan(ROOT, 'qwen3.8-27b', args.lane, 1, 'tp2-shared', args.port)
    cmd = plan['commands'][0]
    name_index = cmd.index('--name') + 1
    cmd[name_index] = args.experiment_id.lower()
    cidfile = runtime / 'container.cid'
    cmd[2:2] = ['--cidfile', str(cidfile), '--label', 'experiment=' + args.experiment_id]
    config = future_config(plan | dict(
        experiment_id=args.experiment_id, launch_command=shlex.join(cmd),
        backend_variant='stock', context_tokens=131072, context_test=True,
        min_context_utilization=.99, prefix_cache_lane='cold-independent',
        chat_template='embedded GGUF Jinja; enable_thinking=false', tool_parser='none',
        thinking=False, endpoint=plan['endpoints'][0],
        notes='WBS 2.1.1; one measured request; no full-size warmup; 2048 output reserve, minimum 256.'))
    if args.retry_of:
        config.update(retry_of=args.retry_of, retry_reason='harness_bug',
                      retry_evidence=args.retry_evidence)
        config = future_config(config)
    h.validate(config)
    h.save(runtime / 'plan.json', plan)
    h.save(runtime / 'planned-config.json', config)
    checkpoint(raw, 'prepared', experiment_id=args.experiment_id, lane=args.lane,
               host=socket.gethostname(), remote_path=str(raw), started_at_utc=h.utc(),
               boot_id=Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip(),
               pid=os.getpid(), process_start_ticks=Path('/proc/self/stat').read_text().split()[21],
               measurement_timeout_s=2400, startup_timeout_s=300,
               scope='WBS 2.1.1: one C1 128K request for this lane',
               cleanup_policy='only cidfile container with matching experiment label',
               planned_config_sha256=h.sha(h.canon(config)),
               source_sha256={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)): h.sha(p.read_bytes()) for p in
                              sorted((ROOT / 'scripts').glob('*.py'))})
    server = None
    stop = threading.Event()
    collector = None
    verdict = 'INCONCLUSIVE'
    error = None
    exit_code = 1
    def telemetry():
        with (runtime / 'gpu-telemetry.jsonl').open('x') as stream:
            while not stop.is_set():
                try:
                    value = command(['nvidia-smi', '--query-gpu=index,uuid,memory.used,power.draw,power.limit,temperature.gpu,clocks.sm,clocks.mem,utilization.gpu', '--format=csv,noheader,nounits'], 5)
                    stream.write(json.dumps(dict(at_utc=h.utc(), csv=value)) + '\n')
                    stream.flush()
                except Exception as exc:
                    stream.write(json.dumps(dict(at_utc=h.utc(), error=str(exc))) + '\n')
                    stream.flush()
                stop.wait(2)
    try:
        inventory = command(['nvidia-smi']) + '\n' + command(['ss', '-ltnp'])
        (runtime / 'host-before.txt').write_text(inventory)
        if command(['nvidia-smi', '--query-compute-apps=pid', '--format=csv,noheader']).strip():
            raise RuntimeError('GPU has an existing compute process; refusing launch')
        with socket.socket() as probe:
            probe.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
            probe.bind(('127.0.0.1', args.port))
        check = launcher.preflight(plan)
        h.save(runtime / 'preflight.json', check)
        if not check['pass']:
            raise RuntimeError('runtime preflight failed')
        artifact = plan['model_identity']
        checksum = command(['sha256sum', artifact['path']], 300).split()[0]
        h.save(runtime / 'artifact-check.json', dict(path=artifact['path'], sha256=checksum,
                                                     expected=artifact['sha256']))
        if checksum != artifact['sha256']:
            raise RuntimeError('model SHA256 mismatch')
        image = cmd[cmd.index('--entrypoint') + 2]
        (runtime / 'runtime-version.txt').write_text(command(['docker', 'run', '--rm', '--pull=never', '--gpus', 'all', '--entrypoint', 'llama-server', image, '--version'], 60))
        collector = threading.Thread(target=telemetry)
        collector.start()
        checkpoint(raw, 'running', step='server_startup')
        with (runtime / 'server-0.log').open('x') as log:
            server = subprocess.Popen(cmd, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        adapter = h.HTTPAdapter(config['endpoint'], 'llama.cpp', timeout_s=5)
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 300
        while not adapter.health()['healthy']:
            if server.poll() is not None:
                log = (runtime / 'server-0.log').read_text(errors='replace').lower()
                verdict = 'FAIL_OOM' if any(x in log for x in ('out of memory', 'cuda error: out of memory')) else 'FAIL_STARTUP'
                raise RuntimeError('server exited during startup')
            if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                verdict = 'FAIL_TIMEOUT'
                raise TimeoutError('startup deadline expired')
            time.sleep(2)
        checkpoint(raw, 'running', step='server_ready', container_id=cidfile.read_text().strip())
        with (runtime / 'measurement.log').open('x') as log:
            child = subprocess.run([sys.executable, __file__, '--worker', str(raw)],
                                   stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=2400)
        if child.returncode:
            raise RuntimeError('measurement worker failed; see measurement.log')
        verdict = json.loads((raw / 'completion.json').read_text())['verdict']
        exit_code = 0
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
        verdict = 'FAIL_TIMEOUT'
        error = str(exc)
    except Exception as exc:
        error = str(exc)
    finally:
        if not (raw / 'completion.json').exists():
            if not (raw / 'config.json').exists():
                h.save(raw / 'config.json', config)
                h.save(raw / 'identity.json', dict(config_sha256=h.sha(h.canon(config)), created_at_utc=h.utc()))
            h.save(raw / 'metrics.json', dict(verdict=verdict, c1_128k=False, error=error))
            h.save(raw / 'completion.json', dict(experiment_id=args.experiment_id, verdict=verdict,
                                                completed_at_utc=h.utc(), error=error))
        cleanup = {'container_stopped': False}
        if cidfile.exists():
            cid = cidfile.read_text().strip()
            try:
                info = json.loads(command(['docker', 'inspect', cid]))[0]
                if info['Config']['Labels'].get('experiment') != args.experiment_id:
                    raise RuntimeError('container ownership mismatch')
                h.save(runtime / 'container-inspect.json', info)
                command(['docker', 'stop', '--time', '10', cid], 30)
                cleanup['container_stopped'] = True
            except Exception as exc:
                cleanup['error'] = str(exc)
        if server:
            try:
                cleanup['server_exit_code'] = server.wait(timeout=30)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                cleanup['server_exit_pending'] = True
        stop.set()
        if collector:
            collector.join(timeout=10)
        h.save(runtime / 'cleanup.json', cleanup)
        (runtime / 'host-after.txt').write_text(command(['nvidia-smi']))
        checkpoint(raw, 'results_saved', step='finished', verdict=verdict, error=error, exit_code=exit_code)
        h.save(runtime / 'exit.json', dict(exit_code=exit_code, verdict=verdict, completed_at_utc=h.utc()))
    return exit_code


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--experiment-id')
    parser.add_argument('--retry-of')
    parser.add_argument('--retry-evidence')
    parser.add_argument('--lane', choices=['TARGET', 'NGRAM'])
    parser.add_argument('--port', type=int, default=18080)
    parser.add_argument('--worker', type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.worker:
        measure(args.worker)
    else:
        if args.retry_of and not args.retry_evidence:
            parser.error('--retry-of requires --retry-evidence')
        if not args.experiment_id or not args.lane:
            parser.error('--experiment-id and --lane are required')
        if not __import__('re').fullmatch(r'EXP-V100-[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9-]*', args.experiment_id):
            parser.error('invalid experiment ID')
        raise SystemExit(run(args))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Validate the v100-skinny boot/runtime witnesses needed before measurements."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse,json,re
from pathlib import Path

def evaluate(text: str, *, tp: int, depth: int) -> dict:
    checks=[]
    def add(name, ok, detail=""): checks.append({"name":name,"ok":bool(ok),"detail":detail})
    m=re.search(r"num_speculative_tokens[^,}\n]*?(\d+)",text)
    served=int(m.group(1)) if m else None
    add("served_depth",served==depth,str(served))
    lm_routes=set(re.findall(r"route map: M=\d+ N=\d{5,} K=\d+ -> ([a-z0-9]+)",text))
    add("lm_head_qpn",bool(lm_routes) and any(x.startswith("qpn") for x in lm_routes),",".join(sorted(lm_routes)))
    fallback=("falling back to requant pack" in text or "packing from the model's own weights" in text)
    add("no_lm_head_repack_fallback",not fallback)
    add("fp16_kv_directive_declined","Ignoring the checkpoint's kv_cache quantization directive" in text)
    scalar=text.count("scalar_paged"); add("zero_scalar_paged",scalar==0,str(scalar))
    add("xqa_active","XQA path active" in text)
    add("qpn2_dispatch",re.search(r"route map: M=\d+ N=\d+ K=\d+ -> qpn2",text) is not None)
    census=len(re.findall(r"QPN8_CENSUS_LOAD",text))
    ineligible=len(re.findall(r"QPN8_CENSUS_LOAD.*eligible=NO",text))
    expected=128*tp
    add("qpn8_census",census==expected and ineligible==0,f"census={census} expected={expected} ineligible={ineligible}")
    add("qpn8_dispatch","route=qpn8" in text)
    return {"pass":all(x["ok"] for x in checks),"tp":tp,"depth":depth,"checks":checks}

def main():
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    ap.add_argument("--log",type=Path,required=True);ap.add_argument("--tp",type=int,default=2)
    ap.add_argument("--depth",type=int,default=3);a=ap.parse_args()
    if a.tp<1 or a.depth<1: raise SystemExit("tp/depth must be positive")
    result=evaluate(a.log.read_text(errors="replace"),tp=a.tp,depth=a.depth)
    print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
    return 0 if result["pass"] else 2
if __name__=="__main__":raise SystemExit(main())

class MeasurementPolicyTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_c1_c2_only(self):

            self.assertEqual(plan["measured_repetitions"], 1)
            self.assertEqual(plan["warmup_count"], 0)
            self.assertEqual(plan["total_intended_requests"], concurrency)
        for concurrency in (0, 3, 4, 5):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                policy.execution_plan(concurrency)

    def test_turns_are_not_repetitions(self):
        plan = policy.execution_plan(2, turns=3)
        self.assertEqual(plan["measured_repetitions"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(plan["measured_batches"], 3)
        self.assertEqual(plan["total_intended_requests"], 6)

    def test_repetitions_and_full_warmup_require_documented_exception(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            policy.future_config({"measured_repetitions": 2})
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            policy.future_config({"warmup_count": 1})
        accepted = policy.future_config(
            {
                "measured_repetitions": 2,
                "repetition_user_request": "explicit test request",
                "warmup_count": 1,
                "full_size_warmup_reason": "explicit technical reason",
                "full_size_warmup_user_approval": "approved for test",
            }
        )
        self.assertEqual(accepted["repetition_count"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(accepted["warmup_count"], 1)

    def test_retry_identity_and_reason(self):
        base = {
            "experiment_id": "EXP-V100-Q38-LLAMA-C1-128K-001",
            "retry_of": "EXP-V100-Q38-LLAMA-C1-128K-001",
            "retry_reason": "harness_bug",
            "retry_evidence": "fixed barrier",
        }
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "new experiment ID"):
            policy.future_config(base)
        retry = base | {"experiment_id": "EXP-V100-Q38-LLAMA-C1-128K-002"}
        self.assertEqual(policy.future_config(retry)["retry_of"], base["retry_of"])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            policy.future_config(retry | {"retry_reason": "failed_once"})
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            policy.future_config(retry | {"retry_reason": "user_authorized"})

import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import unittest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
import build_128k_workload as builder


class FakeAdapter:
    def receipt(self, payload):
        content = payload["messages"][0]["content"]
        return {"source": "fake-char-tokenizer", "prompt_tokens": max(1, len(content) // 4)}


class WorkloadBuilderTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_manifests_load_and_shape(self):
        capacity = builder.load_manifest(ROOT / "workloads/capacity/v1.json")
        concurrency = builder.load_manifest(ROOT / "workloads/concurrency/v1.json")
        performance = builder.load_manifest(ROOT / "workloads/performance/v1.json")
        self.assertEqual(len(capacity["requests"]), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(concurrency["requests"]), 2)
        self.assertEqual(len(performance["requests"]), 2)
        self.assertEqual(capacity["min_output_tokens"], 256)
        self.assertEqual(performance["min_output_tokens"], 1024)
        self.assertTrue(performance["diversify_identifiers"])
        self.assertTrue(concurrency["independent_projects_required"])
        self.assertNotEqual(
            concurrency["requests"][0]["project_id"],
            concurrency["requests"][1]["project_id"],
        )

    def test_capacity_materializes_near_128k(self):
        manifest = builder.load_manifest(ROOT / "workloads/capacity/v1.json")
        result = builder.build(manifest, FakeAdapter(), "mock-model")
        self.assertEqual(len(result["requests"]), 1)
        item = result["build_evidence"][0]
        self.assertLessEqual(item["total_budget_used"], 131072)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(item["utilization"], 0.99)

    def test_c2_materializes_independent_near_128k_prompts(self):
        manifest = builder.load_manifest(ROOT / "workloads/concurrency/v1.json")
        result = builder.build(manifest, FakeAdapter(), "mock-model")
        self.assertEqual(len(result["requests"]), 2)
        hashes = [x["raw_prompt_sha256"] for x in result["build_evidence"]]
        self.assertEqual(len(set(hashes)), 2)
        for item in result["build_evidence"]:
            self.assertLessEqual(item["total_budget_used"], 131072)
            self.assertGreaterEqual(item["utilization"], 0.99)

    def test_performance_diversification_changes_repeated_block(self):
        manifest = builder.load_manifest(ROOT / "workloads/performance/v1.json")
        spec = manifest["requests"][0]
        plain = builder.render(spec, 2, diversify_identifiers=False)
        diverse = builder.render(spec, 2, diversify_identifiers=True)
        self.assertNotEqual(plain, diverse)
        self.assertIn("PageIndex_a_000001", diverse)

    def test_duplicate_c2_project_id_rejected(self):
        manifest = json.loads((ROOT / "workloads/concurrency/v1.json").read_text())
        manifest["requests"][1]["project_id"] = manifest["requests"][0]["project_id"]
        path = ROOT / "workloads/generated/test-invalid.json"
        # Exercise validation without writing generated content.
        import tempfile
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            p = Path(tmp) / "manifest.json"
            p.write_text(json.dumps(manifest))
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                builder.load_manifest(p)

    def test_payload_for_preserves_chat_template_kwargs(self):
        p1 = builder.payload_for("qwen", True, "hello", 256, {}, {"reasoning_effort": "medium"})
        self.assertEqual(p1["chat_template_kwargs"], {"enable_thinking": True, "reasoning_effort": "medium"})
        p2 = builder.payload_for("qwen", False, "hello", 256, {})
        self.assertEqual(p2["chat_template_kwargs"], {"enable_thinking": False})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u -o pipefail

EXPECTED_HOST="${1:-p520-llm}"
ACTUAL_HOST="$(hostname -s 2>/dev/null || hostname)"

if [[ "${ACTUAL_HOST}" != "${EXPECTED_HOST}" ]]; then
  printf 'inventory refused: expected host %s, actual host %s\n' "${EXPECTED_HOST}" "${ACTUAL_HOST}" >&2
  exit 2
fi

section() {
  printf '\n===== %s =====\n' "$1"
}

run() {
  printf '\n$'
  printf ' %q' "$@"
  printf '\n'
  "$@" 2>&1
  local rc=$?
  if (( rc != 0 )); then
    printf '[unavailable/failed rc=%d]\n' "${rc}"
  fi
  return 0
}

run_sh() {
  local command="$1"
  printf '\n$ %s\n' "${command}"
  bash -lc "${command}" 2>&1
  local rc=$?
  if (( rc != 0 )); then
    printf '[unavailable/failed rc=%d]\n' "${rc}"
  fi
  return 0
}

read_file() {
  local path="$1"
  printf '\n$ cat %s\n' "${path}"
  if [[ -r "${path}" ]]; then
    cat "${path}"
  else
    printf '[unavailable: not readable]\n'
  fi
}

section "INVENTORY METADATA"
run date --iso-8601=seconds
run hostname
run hostnamectl
run uname -a
read_file /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
read_file /etc/os-release

section "CPU"
run lscpu
run_sh 'command -v cpupower >/dev/null && cpupower frequency-info || true'
read_file /sys/devices/system/cpu/intel_pstate/no_turbo
read_file /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/cpufreq/scaling_governor
read_file /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/cpufreq/scaling_min_freq
read_file /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/cpufreq/scaling_max_freq

section "MEMORY"
run_sh 'find /sys/devices/system/edac/mc -maxdepth 4 -type f \( -name dimm_label -o -name size -o -name dimm_mem_type -o -name dimm_location \) -print -exec cat {} \;'
run_sh 'if command -v dmidecode >/dev/null; then sudo -n dmidecode --type 17 | sed -E "/Serial Number:|Asset Tag:/d"; else printf "dmidecode unavailable\n"; fi'
run free -h
run_sh 'command -v lsmem >/dev/null && lsmem || true'
read_file /proc/meminfo
run_sh 'command -v numactl >/dev/null && numactl --hardware || true'

section "GPU INVENTORY AND POLICY"
run nvidia-smi
run nvidia-smi -q -d CLOCK,POWER
run nvidia-smi -L
run nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,uuid,name,driver_version,pstate,persistence_mode,power.limit,power.draw,clocks.sm,clocks.mem,memory.total,memory.used,memory.free,temperature.gpu,utilization.gpu --format=csv,noheader,nounits
run nvidia-smi topo -m
run_sh 'nvidia-smi nvlink -s 2>&1 || true'
run_sh 'nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=gpu_uuid,pid,process_name,used_gpu_memory --format=csv,noheader,nounits 2>&1 || true'

section "PCIe"
run_sh 'command -v lspci >/dev/null && lspci -tv || true'
run_sh 'command -v lspci >/dev/null && lspci -nn | grep -iE "NVIDIA|3D controller|VGA compatible" || true'

section "POWER POLICY SERVICES — READ ONLY"
run systemctl is-active nvidia-v100-init.service
run systemctl is-active v100-clock-lock.service
run systemctl is-active cpu-power-tune.service
run_sh 'systemctl cat v100-clock-lock.service 2>&1 || true'
run_sh 'systemctl cat cpu-power-tune.service 2>&1 || true'

section "STORAGE"
run lsblk -o NAME,TYPE,SIZE,FSTYPE,MOUNTPOINTS,MODEL
run df -hT

section "LISTENING PORTS"
run_sh 'command -v ss >/dev/null && ss -ltnp || true'

section "CONTAINERS"
run_sh 'command -v docker >/dev/null && docker ps --format "{{.ID}}\t{{.Image}}\t{{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.Ports}}" || true'
run_sh 'command -v podman >/dev/null && podman ps --format "{{.ID}}\t{{.Image}}\t{{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.Ports}}" || true'
run_sh 'ps -eo pid,ppid,user,comm | grep -iE "llama|vllm|python|docker|podman|PID" || true'

section "RUNTIME DISCOVERY — NO INFERENCE"
run_sh 'for cmd in git docker python3 llama-server llama-bench vllm; do printf "%-14s " "$cmd"; command -v "$cmd" || printf "not-found\n"; done'
run_sh 'git --version 2>&1 || true'
run_sh 'docker --version 2>&1 || true'
run_sh 'python3 --version 2>&1 || true'

section "NETWORK / HOST SUMMARY"
run ip -brief address
run ip route

section "DONE"
printf 'read-only inventory completed on %s\n' "${ACTUAL_HOST}"
